title: Lobby enclosure.
officialText:
The fire service access elevator lobby shall be enclosed with a smoke barrier having a fire-
resistance rating of not less than 1-hour, except that lobby doorways shall comply with Section 3007.6.3.
Exception: Enclosed fire service access elevator lobbies are not required at the levels of exit discharge.
